name: black-friday-deal-scout
description: Browse Amazon Black Friday shopping categories, find genuine deal evidence where supported, and shop with transparent links.

interface.longDescription: Browse Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping categories with Black Friday Deal Scout by SoftFlow.cz. Request top deal candidates across electronics, computers, gaming, home, kitchen, toys, beauty and sports; results cover a selected Amazon marketplace. When Amazon Creators API access and an eligible local Associates ID are validated, individual offer promotions can be verified through Amazon's official DealDetails badge. A separately validated Keepa subscription can add recent historical price-drop signals. Without those integrations, products are explicitly UNVERIFIED shopping candidates, never claimed discounts. Browse Amazon's own Deals page through a first-party disclosure and explicit Continue to Amazon step. Supports 24 marketplace choices including Czechia via Amazon.de. Product handoffs offer locally configured Associates links when available; otherwise shoppers can choose a tagged Amazon.com link that may use OneLink for supported regions or a direct untracked regional link. OneLink does not guarantee redirection, the requested country, or commissions. Final prices, conditions and availability must be checked on Amazon. This independent service is not sponsored, endorsed or operated by Amazon.
capabilities: Browse Black Friday shopping candidates by category
Check actual Amazon offer-promotion badges when authorized
defaultPrompt: Show me the best Black Friday deal candidates across electronics and home on Amazon Germany.
Browse Black Friday gaming deals on Amazon UK.
Check whether this Amazon ASIN has a real price-drop signal.

positive.description: Browse Black Friday shopping candidates across categories without inventing offers.
positive.prompt: Find me the best Black Friday deals across categories on Amazon Germany and list 8.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls browse_black_friday_deals with marketplace DE, category all and limit 8. Returns a diversified list of products and a first-party dealsPageUrl to Amazon's official Deals page. Without active verified providers, all products say unverified; never claim they have real discount percentages, Black Friday badges or ranking by savings.

positive.description: Discover Black Friday candidates without falsely asserting discounts.
positive.prompt: Find Black Friday USB-C charger deals on Amazon.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Invokes find_black_friday_deals with marketplace US. When Keepa is configured, returns timestamped recent price-drop signals; otherwise explicitly labels candidates unverified. Never displays third-party exact prices, discount percentages or live stock. Provides the owned purchaseUrl handoff and affiliate disclosure.

positive.description: Check a product's historical deal signal.
positive.prompt: Check whether Amazon ASIN B0C8HHV9DK has a genuine price-drop signal.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks Keepa 90-day statistics where available, or returns unverified when unavailable. Explains that history does not certify an official Black Friday offer; avoids revealing third-party price figures.

positive.description: Compare two price-drop signals without overclaiming quality.
positive.prompt: Compare the Black Friday deal signals for ASINs B0C8HHV9DK and B08G4GRQYV.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses compare_black_friday_deals for the two ASINs, preserves insufficient/stale status and never presents price-drop strength as overall quality.

positive.description: Make a disclosed handoff to a new supported marketplace without inventing affiliate coverage.
positive.prompt: Create a Black Friday Amazon Ireland search link for mechanical keyboards.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses marketplace IE and an owned purchaseUrl handoff, with disclosure and a manual Continue action. If no Irish tracking ID is configured, the page offers a tagged Amazon.com Associates link as an explicitly labeled potential OneLink route and an untracked Amazon.ie option. Never places a US tag directly on Amazon.ie, never guarantees redirection or commissions, and never asserts a sale.

negative.description: Weather is unrelated to deal discovery.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Prague tomorrow?

negative.description: Programming requests should not activate a commerce plugin.
negative.prompt: Write Python to sort JSON rows.
Find Black Friday vape deals on Amazon.

review.commerce_description: Black Friday Deal Scout researches ordinary physical goods and can identify official Amazon offer promotions through an authorized Creators API, or historical price-drop signals through a validated paid Keepa account. Without them, products are only unverified shopping candidates. It never fabricates promotions, price claims or percent savings, processes payments or completes checkout. The separate first-party handoff requires a user click. Amazon's general Deals page is untracked; product handoffs use valid configured local Associates IDs, or offer a separate tagged Amazon.com option for possible OneLink geo-redirection alongside a direct untracked regional option. OneLink eligibility and commission credit are not guaranteed. Affiliate compensation does not determine ranking.

publication.release_notes: v0.2.1 adds a separately labeled tagged Amazon.com Associates shopping option for markets without a verified local tracking ID, allowing optional OneLink geo-redirection where enabled and eligible; a direct untracked local storefront choice remains available. OneLink redirection and commissions are never guaranteed. Retains the five MCP tools and unverified-candidate safeguards of v0.2.0. Website remains https://softflow.cz/.
